profile:
model = "gpt-6-astra"
model_reasoning_effort = "high"
approval_policy = "never"
default_permissions = "trial"
web_search = "disabled"
project_doc_max_bytes = 0
allow_login_shell = false
[features]
apps = false
multi_agent = false
remote_plugin = false
shell_snapshot = false
[plugins._default]
enabled = false
[permissions.trial.filesystem]
":minimal" = "read"
"/System/Library/OpenSSL" = "read"
"<control>/repository" = "read"
"<control>/results/auxiliary" = "write"
"<control>/results" = "write"
"<control>/home" = "write"
"<cache>" = "read"
"<control>/node" = "read"
"<control>/input-1" = "read"
"<control>/input-2" = "read"
"/Users" = "deny"
"<repository>" = "deny"
"<control>/config.toml" = "deny"
[permissions.trial.network]
enabled = false
[shell_environment_policy]
inherit = "none"
scope: Known calibration/complete-root in copied read-only evaluator, explicit host-home deny, network denied; detached process gate remains open
